files.description: Cloud storage accounts (150 rows): account_id (whole number), active (True or False), quota_bytes (storage limit in bytes, whole number; the 23 unlimited accounts carry the value 9223372036854775807), used_bytes (whole number). No empty cells.

task_text: Each account gets a control total: its active flag counted as 1 (True) or 0 (False), plus quota_bytes, plus used_bytes. `result` should be a Series of control totals indexed by account_id, with exact whole numbers.
intended_computation: For each of the 150 accounts: (1 if active else 0) + quota_bytes + used_bytes as an exact integer (the 23 unlimited accounts carry the largest 64-bit value, so their totals can exceed the 64-bit range).

predicted_direction.reason: The row-wise sum over a frame mixing a true/false column and integers used exact Python integers on 2.x; on 3.1 it uses 64-bit integers and the unlimited accounts wrap around to negative totals.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row I06; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
